title: hubHomeProjects
responsibility: Groups hosted catalog entries by kind and collects recent phases for the home project preview.

inputs.name: projectInventory.snapshot
inputs.description: The current published snapshot, if available for the operation.

inputs.name: inventorySummary.inventory
inputs.description: Grouped counts and changes from a published catalog.

outputs.name: projectInventory
outputs.description: Counts of published apps, pages and components and the sorted recent changes.

outputs.name: inventorySummary
outputs.description: Compact sentence listing the three catalog counts.
